prompts.cat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for cute 2D animal companions. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, exact regular grid of FIVE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, twenty separate animals total, equal cells, each creature centered with generous empty gutters, all fully visible. NO text, no numbers, no panels, no grid lines, no background, no scenery. Readable small silhouettes, crisp dark chocolate outline, flat cel colors with one shadow tone, soft playful chunky shapes, minimal tiny dot eyes, NOT 3D, not glossy, not anthropomorphic, no clothing, no tools, not emoji or clipart. Each ROW is a distinct feline that evolves LEFT TO RIGHT through five radically distinguishable growth stages. Row1: cream ordinary house kitten; orange tabby cat; young striped tiger; white tiger with teal mane and little horns; majestic cute white celestial tiger with jade horns and cloud shaped tail. Row2: round tawny lion cub; fluffy young lion; orange lion with flame mane; red lion with larger sunburst mane; golden mythical sun lion with blazing circular mane. Row3: tiny gray bobcat kitten; tuft eared spotted lynx; silver long eared lynx; jade guardian lynx with leaf-like cheek tufts; emerald mythical forest lynx with antler-shaped ear tufts. Row4: small white snow kitten; fluffy blue-white snow cat; spotted snow leopard cub; purple-white snow leopard with double curled tail; elegant cute spectral snow leopard with three flowing violet tails. Maintain distinct row identities across stages; all five levels must visibly differ by anatomy, markings and silhouette, not just color. Final mythic forms still compact and adorable. Canvas approximately 5:4 aspect, twenty equally sized cells. Transparent background with true alpha.
prompts.dragon: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production game sprite atlas, using the provided feline atlas ONLY as style reference: cute flat 2D animal line art with small expressive faces, crisp dark outlines, cel shadows, no 3D. Exactly FIVE COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS on transparent background, twenty full animals in equally sized square cells. Leave 12% empty margin INSIDE EACH CELL so there is zero overlap, no touching between rows or columns. Center each creature in its cell, ALL creatures approximately equal visual size. Each row evolves left-to-right through five distinct silhouettes. NO text, numerals, panels, grid lines, background or clothing. These are original game animals, no recognizable franchise designs. True alpha transparency. Row1 (lightning): small blue water snake, cobalt snake with tiny fin ears, azure serpent with two legs and long whiskers, four-legged turquoise dragon with small horns, cute celestial thunder dragon with branching horns and lightning-shaped mane. Row2 (fire): tiny red salamander, orange crested lizard, red drake with small wings, crimson horned fire dragon, adorable scarlet mythical dragon with flame-shaped wings. Row3 (piercing): small violet viper, purple snake with angular cheek fins, long lavender serpent with jade tail blade, dark purple wyrm with sharp crystal fins, purple cosmic dragon with a crescent horn and ribbon body. Row4 (timed charge): tiny green gecko, yellow-green crested gecko, jade lizard with mushroom-like back plates, turquoise drake with rounded glowing spore plates, mossy forest dragon with huge curled leaf tail and softly glowing seed-shaped scales.
